about: F-ZOOM-NONE (#388, D-SHIP-TEXTZOOM): the library rows that ship with no drawn posture close-up. A row may be listed only when its sheet has no posture zoom and every posture zoom of its research card is a ruled text checkpoint: checkpoints maps each card zoom key to the sheet's posture checkpoint key that carries it. ruling must be one of gen/zooms.mjs TEXT_ZOOM_RULINGS. Checked by gen/zooms.mjs textZoomRow. Entries are added by the wave that ships the row.
